kind: Retrospective validated-arithmetic extension, fixed before endpoint evaluation.
dataset: All 9284 previously stored uncorrected warm endpoints, in original order; no solver calls, observations, thresholds, seeds, or histories changed.
semantics: Original raw coordinates and observation binary64 values denote exact real values. Exact inner preimage preserves the original mapped output. All interval decisions use exact Python integers; libm exp and sqrt are not used.
metrics: false acceptances against independent direct-cone intervals
reference: Independent ideal-metric cone reduction in 256-bit outward intervals. Report any reference threshold overlap; do not label it accurate or inaccurate.
comparisons: Previous float64 pointwise records at the same physical states. Ordinary-float discrepancies do not define error budgets.
restrictions: Nominal ideal four-analyzer quadratic only; no real-camera calibration or imaging-truth certification, new interval theory, runtime superiority, unseen-scene generalization, or optimizer convergence claim.
stress_inputs: 43 fixed inputs: 33 chart/intensity, 6 stationary-fold, 4 unsupported-input cases.
